name: Accidental Textbook Lesson
effect: Every answer turns into an empty textbook lesson: "Let's explore this concept", "Scenario:", "metaphorical connection". The answers are circular and repeat themselves, and they keep drifting into statistics, math, physics or health lessons
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs. Passed every check, judged alone.
